from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class QuarterlyLiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of a specific liability line item extracted from a financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company reported")
    report_year: str | None = Field(description="The year of the report period")
    report_quarter: str | None = Field(description="The quarter of the report period")
    line_item_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the specific liability line item")
    balance_beginning_of_period: float | None = Field(description="Balance at the start of the period")
    balance_end_of_period: float | None = Field(description="Balance at the end of the period")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g., CNY, RMB)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    liability_records: list[QuarterlyLiabilityRecord]
